description_en: Updates the service log configurations of a project
description_zh: 更新一个Project的服务日志配置
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-logging --project ali-test-project --logging-project my-project --logging-details type=consumergroup_log logstore=my-logstore --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLogging

parameters.help_en: The name of the project to which you want to save service logs
parameters.help_zh: 服务日志要保存到的 project 名称
parameters.name: logging_project

element_fields.help_en:
The type of service logs. Valid values:

- consumergroup\_log: the consumption delay logs of consumer groups.

- logtail\_alarm: the alert logs of Logtail.

- operation\_log: the operation logs.

- logtail\_profile: the collection logs of Logtail.

- metering: the metering logs.

- logtail\_status: the status logs of Logtail.

- scheduledsqlalert: the operational logs of Scheduled SQL jobs.

- etl\_alert: the operational logs of data transformation jobs
element_fields.help_zh:
服务日志的种类。取值包括：

-  consumergroup_log：消费组延迟日志
-  logtail_alarm：消费组延迟日志
- operation_log：操作日志
- logtail_profile：Logtail采集日志
- metering：计量日志
- logtail_status：Logtail状态日志
- scheduled_sql_alert：Scheduled SQL作业运行日志
-  etl_alert：数据加工作业的运行日志
element_fields.name: type

element_fields.help_en: The name of the Logstore to which you want to save service logs
element_fields.help_zh: 该种类服务日志要保存到的Logstore名称
element_fields.name: logstore
